body:
Talk to the teacher on the LAN (llama.cpp / vLLM, OpenAI-compatible API, no API key). Prompts live in an editable YAML file; `:context` shows the exact model input.

**Done when:** a request returns a proposal from the endpoint, and a stub backend returning fixed proposals exists for tests.

---
**Design review 2026-10-14** (#63)

**Split.** The HTTP client moved to #77. This issue is now: the prompts YAML, `:context` showing the exact model input, and a **stub backend that records every prompt it was sent** (the sudo test in #13 relies on it). File locations per #70; proposal format per #68.

**Done when:** `:context` matches what the stub received byte for byte, and the stub's recorded prompts are available to tests.
title: M0.8 — Prompts YAML, :context and a recording stub backend
